report:
Brain, right frontal lesion, stereotactic biopsy

Two smear preparations are made from the tissue. They show cohesive clusters of large epithelioid cells with well-defined cytoplasmic borders against a non-fibrillary background. Sections show two pieces of tissue comprising brain parenchyma infiltrated by a metastatic adenocarcinoma forming glands and solid nests with a sharp interface against the surrounding gliotic brain. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are positive for TTF-1 and CK7 and negative for CK20.

BRAIN, right frontal lobe, stereotactic biopsy - METASTATIC ADENOCARCINOMA, consistent with a lung primary
